canonical_name: Cyber Resilience Recovery Plan Not Established
description: A comprehensive recovery plan for restoring operations after cyber incidents is not established. This signal indicates that recovery from significant attacks may be prolonged or incomplete.
applicability: Applicable to Level 3 environments requiring operational resilience. Includes disaster recovery, business continuity, and cyber resilience planning.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through recovery plan review, recovery testing verification, and RTO/RPO assessment.
